title: Carlo d'Aragona Tagliavia, duke of Terranova (governor of Milan) → Paolo Sfondrati, Spanish ambassador in Savoy: letter partly in cipher, Milan
correspondents: Carlo d'Aragona Tagliavia, duke of Terranova → Paolo Sfondrati, baron of Valsassina
shelfmark: Brigham Young University, L. Tom Perry Special Collections, Vault MSS 518 (Paolo Sfondrati correspondence), folder 3, item 2
folio_note: 4 page images (CONTENTdm SCMisc 53906, pages 53902-53905); p. 1 has 5 lines of clear Spanish then about 17 lines of cipher, continued on p. 2
status: BYU item note: "Portions of letter written in code." Viewed 11 Nov 2026: no decipherment on the leaf. Same hand, cipher and month as the 13 cipher letters of Vault MSS 771 (catalogue 2077); folder 3 of MSS 518 holds 38 more Terranova letters of 1583 in clear. Not on DECODE.
why: The governor of Milan to Philip II's ambassador at Turin in the weeks of the Savoy marriage negotiations and the Saluzzo question; it belongs with catalogue 2077 and should be worked with it.
score_note: Scored from the page images during the 11 Nov 2026 US/UK leftovers sweep (research/sweep_2026-11-11_us_uk_leftovers/); pages 1-2 viewed at 900 px
verify: Transcribe with the 2077 set (about 30 cipher pages in all, clear passages in the same letters as cribs). Test the DECODE key R9318 ("Duca di Terranova") and compare BL Add MS 28418 (decipherings of Sfondrati's own letters, 1580-85).
prior_art: open (checked 11 Nov 2026: DECODE search, cryptiana Spanish/Savoy/Italian pages, Lasry list, web searches; no decipherment found)
access_note: Images open on cdm15999.contentdm.oclc.org (IIIF, no login); the host answers from this network though it timed out on 3 Nov

seen.where: BYU CONTENTdm SCMisc 53906, IIIF pages 53902 and 53903 downloaded at 900 px and read
seen.extent: p. 1: about 17 lines of cipher after 5 clear lines; p. 2: 3 more cipher lines, the dating clause "De Milan a 5 de 8bre 1583" and the signature
seen.cipher: Spanish chancery cipher of the Philip II type: numbers (8, 11, 14, 17, 33, 38, 58 ...), small letter signs with dots and strokes above, two-letter groups (re, xa, be, ge) and three-letter words (hom, sim, hol, vil, com, roe). No interlinear or marginal decipherment and no deciphered copy among the four images.

searches.query: WebSearch: Sfondrati family letters 1583 Carlo d'Aragona Tagliavia Paolo Sfondrati cipher "Vault MSS 771" OR "Brigham Young" deciphered
searches.result: Nothing on the BYU letters: hits were Mary Stuart, Ferdinand of Aragon (CNI 2018), Valle de la Cerda and other unrelated decipherments.

searches.query: WebSearch: duque de Terranova gobernador de Milán 1583 cartas cifradas Paolo Sfondrato embajador Saboya Turín cifra descifrado
searches.result: Scalisi, "La correspondencia del duque de Terranova" (Libros de la Corte, 2023: his government 1580-86, Escorial papers) and a 1583 instruction by Scipio di Castro; no decipherment of letters to Sfondrati. The Scalisi PDF sits behind an Anubis bot check on revistas.uam.es and was not opened.

searches.query: WebSearch: "Paolo Sfondrati correspondence" BYU "Vault MSS 518" Carlo d'Aragona Tagliavia letter 1583 October code
searches.result: Only the SNAC stub for BYU "Paolo Sfondrati correspondence" and a CCFr record of a copy of Sfondrato to Philip II, 13 Dec 1582; no study, transcription or decipherment of the 5 Oct 1583 letter.

searches.query: WebSearch: "Add MS 28418" Sfondrato embajador Saboya Felipe II cartas descifradas 1583 Terranova cifra
searches.result: BL Add MS 28418: "copies and decipherings of letters from Paolo Sfondrato, Count of Riviera, Spanish ambassador at Turin, to Philip II and Juan de Idiaquez", 1580-85. That is Sfondrati's own outgoing mail in the royal cipher, not Terranova's letters to him; a place to look for the same cipher, no reading of this letter.

searches.query: DECODE RecordsList search (curl, cmd=search): Sfondrati; Terranova; Tagliavia; Brigham
searches.result: Sfondrati 0, Tagliavia 0, Brigham 0. Terranova 1: R9318, a key headed "Duca di Terranova" in Munich, BayHStA Kurbayern Äußeres Archiv 4591 f. 95 (no ciphertext, not these letters).

searches.query: cryptiana.web.fc2.com: spanish2, spanish2A-C, spanish3, savoy, savoy2, italian .htm fetched and grepped for Terranova / Sfondrat
searches.result: No occurrence of either name on any of the eight pages.

prior_art.decode: DECODE RecordsList searched 11 Nov 2026 for Sfondrati, Tagliavia and Brigham (0 records each) and Terranova (1: R9318, a "Duca di Terranova" key at Munich, BayHStA KAA 4591 f. 95). No record of this letter or of any BYU item.
prior_art.tomokiyo: Fetched cryptiana spanish2, spanish2A, spanish2B, spanish2C, spanish3, savoy, savoy2 and italian.htm and grepped for Terranova and Sfondrat: no hit. The repo copy unsolved.htm has neither name.
prior_art.lasry: targets/gramont1529/GL.htm (the repo copy of Lasry's list) grepped for Sfondrat, Terranova, Tagliavia: no hit; the web searches returned no Lasry or DECRYPT paper on Milan-Turin Spanish traffic of 1583.
prior_art.edition: No edition or calendar of Terranova's letters to the ambassador in Savoy was found. Scalisi's 2023 article on Terranova's correspondence (Escorial papers) is a study, not an edition; its PDF was not opened (Anubis check on revistas.uam.es). BL Add MS 28418 holds contemporary decipherings of Sfondrati's own letters to Philip II, a different side of the correspondence.
prior_art.literature: Web searches on Terranova/Sfondrato with cifra/descifrado and on the BYU shelfmarks returned no cryptologic or historical paper reading these letters; BYU's item notes say only "Portions of letter written in code".

vetting.key_check: No key is filed with the letter. Not tested: DECODE R9318 (Terranova key, Munich) and the Philip II general ciphers printed by Devos and on cryptiana spanish3.htm; no key was tried in this pass.
vetting.key_held: DECODE R9318, key headed "Duca di Terranova" (BayHStA Kurbayern Äußeres Archiv 4591 f. 95): not tested, date and correspondent unknown. BL Add MS 28418 (decipherings of Sfondrati's letters 1580-85) may show the same nomenclator: not seen.
vetting.duplicates: known.py "MSS 518", "Sfondrati", "Tagliavia": only catalogue 2077 (Vault MSS 771, the sibling set) and its sweep notes; this item (MSS 518 f. 3 item 2) is not in 2077. DECODE search: no record.

title: Ivy Neville-Rolfe (Naples) → Lord Dufferin: 15 letters on linguistic matters and ciphers, "some letters in code"
correspondents: Ivy Neville-Rolfe → Frederick Hamilton-Temple-Blackwood, 1st Marquess of Dufferin and Ava
shelfmark: PRONI, Dufferin and Ava Papers, D1071/H/B/N/60

why: A private cipher exchange between the ambassador at Rome and the consul's daughter at Naples; a pastime cipher, small historical weight.
